name: Tasks & Projects
description: Creating, organizing and scheduling work: tasks, subtasks, boards, timelines, dependencies, templates and bulk task changes.

name: Collaboration
description: Working with other people inside Orbit: comments, @mentions, sharing, guest access and real-time editing.

name: Notifications
description: How and when Orbit alerts people: email, browser push and in-app alerts, digests, reminders and notification settings.

name: Reporting & Analytics
description: Seeing and exporting data about work: dashboards, charts, exports and time tracking reports.

name: Integrations & API
description: Connecting Orbit to other tools and code: Slack, GitHub, calendars, webhooks and the public API.

name: Admin & Security
description: Workspace administration and protection: SSO, roles and permissions, audit logs, authentication policy and data controls.

name: UI/UX & Accessibility
description: How the web app looks and is operated: themes, layout and density, keyboard shortcuts and accessibility.
